pixel_coords: x right, y down, full-resolution pixels of the 2560x2560 video
description: Product close-up render (Blender): a white rubber-bulb dropper cap with a glass pipette is held tilted (tip lower-left, bulb upper-right) above an open frosted amber 'NOVA / RADIANCE / VITAMIN B' serum bottle. The pipette is partly filled with amber serum; a single air bubble inside the liquid slides down the pipette toward the tip. A drop of serum hangs from the pipette tip and does not detach. Everything except the bubble is static.

camera.evidence: phase correlation of the upper-right background/cap region between frames 0 and 49: shift (0.002, -0.008) px; per-frame shifts < 0.01 px. Small global mean change at frames 17-18 is render-noise only (no shift).
camera.perspective: 2D scene; close-up product shot viewed slightly from below. No ground plane or horizon visible. Bubble moves along the pipette axis, which is a straight line in the image.

bubble.description: Single round air bubble inside the amber liquid column of the glass pipette (the only bubble). Clear/bright with refracted highlights, ~100 px diameter.
bubble.reference_point: centroid of the convex-hull bubble mask (approximates the bubble's centre/origin)
bubble.motion_direction: down-left along the pipette axis, unit vector (-0.855, 0.519), 31.25 deg below horizontal
bubble.apparent_size_px: diameter ~104-110 px along axis, ~88-100 px across axis (mask includes refraction rim); essentially constant; mean area ~8300 px^2 (equivalent circle diameter ~103 px)

pipette_glass_tube.description: Clear glass dropper tube, axis ~31 deg below horizontal; from tip (lower-left) into the white cap (upper-right)
pipette_glass_tube.taper: narrows to a bulbous tip region x 205-330, y 1640-1830
pipette_glass_tube.reliability: edges read off a 50 px grid, +-10 px

liquid_column_in_pipette.description: Amber serum inside the pipette, from the tip up to an upper meniscus
liquid_column_in_pipette.lower_end: continuous to the tip and into the hanging drop
liquid_column_in_pipette.moves: no visible change of the meniscus over the clip

hanging_drop.description: Teardrop of serum hanging from the pipette tip; stays attached, no falling in frames 0-49

dropper_cap.description: White matte rubber bulb + collar cap, open end facing down-left toward the bottle; axis parallel to the pipette
dropper_cap.reliability: +-20 px (soft, low-contrast edges against the wall)

bottle.description: Frosted glass bottle filled with amber serum, clear threaded neck, open (cap removed). Bottom out of frame.

background_wall.description: Light beige backdrop with diagonal soft shadow stripes (window-blind light pattern); static

events.note: displacement < 2 px/frame for frames 1-3; clearly moving from frame 4
per-frame displacement grows from ~2 to ~12 px

events.event: bubble decelerating as it enters the tapered tip region
hanging drop: no release, no fall
